record_notes.DCP-LETT-1840: March 9, 1856, four full blocks, nine notes and bibliography read. Manuscript missing; earliest known Sydney Mail 1884 printed witness differs from later de Beer version. September4 Covington letter received a month or six weeks earlier, approximate arrival only and incoming text missing. Oral Sulivan conversation and heard seaman letter are indirect sources; Beagle-as-collier hearsay contradicted by editorial history must remain attributed historical belief. Barnacle book now finished; forty-sovereign gold weight is medal comparison, not payment or nugget receipt. Keeping domestic birds and request for rare imported skins are current activities/proposals, not receipt of those specimens. Stokes future service prediction remains qualified I believe. Historical colonial and livelihood opinions are author voice, not validated modern conclusions.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2056: February22,1857, three complete blocks, five notes and bibliography read. Source descriptions give Sydney Mail1884 and de Beer1959 printed versions, no original manuscript inspection claimed. September14 incoming Covington letter acknowledged a short time since; financial difficulty chiefly new-house cost is Darwin interpretation, not independently verified accounts. Six boys/two girls family comparison; William future barrister plan not actual career. Sulivan salary £1000 is qualified I believe and appointment news precedes this letter. FitzRoy lunch tomorrow is planned, not happened; only-daughter assertion and estimated age remain historical wording beside excluded editorial family information. Macarthur dinner and wine tasting past experience; later Australian greatness a prediction. Corington printing issue corrected in current edition, no wholesale modernization of witness.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-3059: February4, supplied1856 ALS, three blocks, five notes and bibliography read. Source is Galton archive manuscript record. Prior Norton Shaw information and unanswered letter to Erhardt are reported; seeks Galton influence, explicitly no reply demanded. Erhardt spelling questioned by Darwin, not silently normalized from authority identity. Later Variation citation indicates subsequent information but does not prove already received in February. Family sickness improving, intended London visit missed; no actual Galton meeting inferred. High catalogue number is not a1861 date.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2121: July7, supplied1857 ALS. Four blocks, five notes and bibliography read. Enclosed document returned signed is unidentified; possible Royal Geographical Society connection is editorial inference only. Thanks missing Galton information about Barth work, says will read and will ask after reading; not proof of completed reading or possession of all five volumes. First three volumes May1857 publication differs from final1858 five-volume set. Says cattle will not be taken in detail here despite later Variation coverage; do not replace current intention with later outcome. Requests observations about deliberate breeding; historical savage wording retained as attributed source, no synthetic modern prompt.

reading_method: Root independently read complete surviving new source bodies, metadata constraints, exclusions, footnotes, scholarly sections and bibliography. Actual special markup and figures inspected where present. Reused explicit accepted primary readings only after matching source and accepted evidence hashes. Historical decisions and notes are handwritten; validation packages evidence rather than adjudicating it.
